children: Paid said on X that fees collected through the platform over the past 24 hours reached $1.54 million, 26 times the previous day’s total and more than the sum of the prior seven days. According to Odaily, Paid temporarily set each user’s daily payout limit at $750 because of surging demand and because weekend ACH deposits had not yet arrived. The company expects normal payouts to resume after ACH funds arrive on September 28.

title: Paid Fee Revenue Reaches $1.54 Million in 24 Hours as Daily Payout Cap Is Set at $750
